name: Bridgestone 350 GTR / 175 Hurricane
engine: 177 or 345 cc air-cooled rotary-valve two-stroke twin, oil injection
intro: Bridgestone's high-quality two-stroke twins. Rotary valves, oil injection and parts that are now very hard to find.

B: It has oil injection, not premix. Keep the oil tank filled and check the pump before you start it.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
